name: seed-modules-flag-derivation-unpinned
body: Limit: the planned-flag derivation (status == "planned" exactly, NULL/other = real) is observable only through a live db.lbug query, so no pure unit/int test pins it directly; the proof is the Phase-4 still-planned e2e plus the splice e2e tier. Upgrade if the status vocabulary ever grows beyond NULL/'planned'.
